Almanac.Title: Lunar Almanac
Almanac.NoEmber: The Lunar Almanac needs the Ember module.
Almanac.NoCalendar: Ember's calendar is not ready. It needs the scenes of the Ember adventure in this world.

uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of the Lunar Almanac for you. Follow Foundry uses Foundry's language.

phaseAlert.name: Phase notifications
phaseAlert.hint: Which phase changes you are told about when the world time moves on.
phaseAlert.attuned: Every change of a moon or realm a hero is attuned to

chatAlert.name: Full moons in the chat
chatAlert.hint: The GM's client posts a chat message for everyone when a moon becomes full or a realm becomes dominant.

timelineDays.name: Timeline length
timelineDays.hint: How many days the timeline of the almanac shows. 0 hides it.

calendarButton.name: Button in Ember's calendar
calendarButton.hint: A moon button next to the cosmos button of Ember's calendar opens the almanac.

controlButton.name: Button in the token controls
controlButton.hint: Adds the almanac to the token tools on the left.

SELFTEST.Title: Lunar Almanac self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks the parts of Ember that the almanac reads. Run it after an Ember or Foundry update.
SELFTEST.Passed: Self test passed: {checks} checks, {moons} moons, {realms} realms, {heroes} attuned heroes.
SELFTEST.Problems: Self test: {problems} of {checks} checks failed. See the chat message.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: The Lunar Almanac was verified with older versions than {versions}. Run the self test in the module settings to check that everything still works.
SELFTEST.EmberInactive: The Ember module is not active.
SELFTEST.NoCalendar: Ember's calendar is not ready (the Ember adventure scenes are missing or Ember failed to start).
SELFTEST.MoonCount: Ember's calendar has {count} moons instead of 6.
SELFTEST.RealmCount: Ember's calendar has {count} inner realms instead of 3.
SELFTEST.Units: The time units of the calendar could not be read.
SELFTEST.Phase: The phase of {name} could not be computed.
SELFTEST.Forecast: The next phase change of {name} could not be found.
SELFTEST.Image: The image of {name} could not be loaded: {src}
SELFTEST.Rank: Ember's attunement rank function is missing, ranks are not shown.
SELFTEST.Heroes: None of the player characters has an Ember attunement.
